name: API Browser
author: Brett
description: Every API path of the console in one place: control@1 targets and actions, every plugin read and command, the MCP tools, the console's REST routes and the axf CLI, from one generated registry (framework/cli/api-registry.mjs). Grid (sort, filter, search), Tree (app › plugin › kind › path), Cards and Coverage (every UI element of the console and the API path that reaches it, red for gaps). Each path shows what it does, its input schema, its policy (instant, veto, confirm, approval, Brett's tap), its REST, MCP and CLI names, the UI elements it stands for and its docs, and Try it runs it from here under the same policy as any click in the console.
